title: Yara and the Harbor
author: Lena Sandoval
blurb: Dominic Ravensworth, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
